name: Jiangsu Jiangnan Water Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Jiangnan Water Co., Ltd. supplies water in China. The company engages in tap water production and sales, drainage and related water treatment, water supply engineering design and technical consulting, water quality testing and meter testing, and investment in public infrastructure. It also owns 3 surface water plants with a daily water supply capacity of 1.1 million cubic meters.
